subject.title: fix(media): make wake-false direct fallback reason-aware

question: For #97275, is the internal scheduler/Mantis manifest proof sufficient, or should merge wait for live gateway or Telegram proof via the generated-media wake-false proof stack?
rationale: The code path is source-supported, but the external PR lacks after-fix real behavior proof and the latest Mantis artifact explicitly skipped normal Telegram Desktop behavior.

options.title: Require Live Proof
options.body: Keep the PR paused until a redacted gateway log, channel recording, or proof-stack Mantis artifact shows the allowlisted wake-false generated-media fallback delivers exactly once.

options.title: Accept Scheduler Proof
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the mocked scheduler matrix and internal Mantis fixed marker as sufficient for this hard-to-expose internal failure mode.

options.title: Wait For Harness Stack
options.body: Keep this implementation draft open until #97308 or #97448 produces the baseline/candidate proof needed for the final merge boundary.

recommendation.title: Require Live Proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR paused until a redacted gateway log, channel recording, or proof-stack Mantis artifact shows the allowlisted wake-false generated-media fallback delivers exactly once.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent generated-media delivery routing work and the #86034 reopen note make this the clearest available owner for the proof-sufficiency decision.
